assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: unique cover image for a Persian professional guide about evaluating a website design studio, project scope, portfolio evidence and acceptance quality. Primary request: a premium editorial 3D scene showing a central elegant glass website architecture model on a black stone worktable, with three distinct translucent layers: a purposeful user path of connected mint points, carefully arranged page panels, and a precision inspection lens examining one panel. It should communicate considered planning and verifiable design quality. Scene: refined dark studio with architectural depth, luminous glass and brushed metal, subtle cyan reflections. Composition: one cohesive wide landscape 16:9 image, central subject safe for cover cropping, visually compelling with disciplined negative space. Color palette: midnight teal #001014 and #031b22, luminous mint/cyan #00dfd6 and #76e8db, restrained white. Polished cinematic 3D rendering, tactile materials, crisp purposeful forms. No lettering, no logos, no watermark, no tiny gibberish UI text, no fake metrics, no client screenshot, no multi-panel collage.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: first in-article illustration for a Persian guide to evaluating a web design studio portfolio. Materials: smoky glass, brushed dark metal, dark stone. Lighting: luminous cyan rim lighting with subtle soft white highlights, sophisticated studio atmosphere. Palette: midnight teal #001014 and #031b22, mint cyan #00dfd6 and #76e8db. No logos, no watermark, no lettering or tiny gibberish UI text, no statistics, no collage.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: second in-article illustration for a Persian guide about converting a website proposal into concrete deliverables and acceptance criteria. Primary request: premium polished editorial 3D visualization of a modular website project being assembled on a refined dark stone desk. Exactly three substantial translucent glass page models stand on an architectural plan; elegant mint connection rails lead to a solid illuminated acceptance checkmark sculpted from frosted glass. A metal drafting compass and a short neat stack of blank deliverable cards convey a defined project scope. Each page model has a different simple purposeful structure made of blank geometric blocks, no words. Show a clear orderly progression from blueprint to assembled working pages to final acceptance, as one coherent physical scene, not an infographic panel grid. Composition: wide landscape 16:9 with a low three-quarter viewpoint, central objects with generous breathing room, beautiful tactile details. Color palette midnight teal #001014 and #031b22, luminous mint/cyan #00dfd6 and #76e8db, restrained white. Dark glass, black stone, brushed metal; cinematic soft lighting. No logos, watermark, lettering, unreadable tiny UI, fake data, client screenshots or collage.
